reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule and extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but getDatesInRange re-spells the private isNonBusinessDay check inline and does not share the daily-skip logic with getNextDate.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule is implemented twice (a while loop in getNextDate and a continue in getDatesInRange), and the weekend-or-holiday predicate is written once as isNonBusinessDay and again inline.

placement.why: Holiday and weekend logic sits in shared/schedules.ts as it should, but the daily-skip decision lives in two callers rather than next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the schedule date code, the type and tests; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: The rule is scattered: getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule-template still adjust dates without the daily-skip and (in the template) without holidays, and the range padding of 3 + holidays.length is an ad hoc guess.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange inlines d.isWeekend || isHoliday and its own daily-skip instead of a shared helper; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays

disguised_duplication.where: daily-skip as a while loop in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate vs a continue in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange; isNonBusinessDay re-expressed inline as d.isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(date, holidays)

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; the daily-frequency special case is handled outside it in getNextDate and getDatesInRange (reimplemented), getUpcomingDates omits the daily skip and schedule-template.ts omits holidays and daily skip
